summary: The Select Board discussed member reappointment processes [00:00] before evaluating proposed code of conduct guidelines regarding public statements, information gathering, and interactions with staff and vendors [11:20]. The board considered policies on hybrid meeting accessibility [38:40] and public comment rules [46:55], followed by a presentation on a new online roadmap tracker for municipal goals [53:19]. Members reviewed twenty warrant articles for the Fall Special Town Meeting [1:17:03] and voted to place the warrant articles for the meeting [1:19:19]. The board further deliberated on Article 17 regarding Community Preservation Act funding for affordable housing [1:23:26] and Article 18 regarding proposed revisions to the free cash policy allocation cap [2:01:59]. Lastly, the board voted to approve appointments to the Brookline Youth Council [2:47:33].
